title: Tesla Reports Flat Revenue and Lower Profits in Q3
excerpt: Tesla's third-quarter earnings show flatlined revenues and a four percent drop in profits, despite recent product demonstrations.
body_html:
Tesla has released its financial results for the third quarter ending in September 2026. The company reported $28.0 billion in revenue, which remained flat compared to previous figures.

During the same quarter, Tesla earned $1.7 billion in net income. However, profits experienced a four percent decline.

The financial update follows the company's recent Roadster demonstration.
